visitePro.fermerNote: Closing now ends the tour. You will find it again in « Réglages », under « {{revoir}} ».
visitePro.exempleNote: This order does not exist: it shows you what you will see when a real one comes in.
visitePro.exempleDetail: Blue gate, next to the school
visitePro.commandesTexte: Every new order appears on its own, with nothing to refresh. You accept it, or decline it with a reason, then move it to preparation, and finally mark it ready.
visitePro.livraisonTexte: As soon as an order is marked ready, it leaves the first tab and comes here. As soon as a courier picks it up, their name and number appear on the order, until it reaches the customer.
visitePro.historiqueTexte: All your finished orders, delivered as well as declined, with their details and their amounts.
visitePro.reglagesTexte: Your logo and your cover photo, the phone number shown to your customers, your opening hours day by day, opening and closing. Under « À l'affiche » you add a dish of the day or a special of the moment; the star features a dish from your menu, and the switch flags what has run out.
visitePro.basculeTitre: See the app as your customers do
visitePro.basculeTexte: The « App client » button, top right, shows you the app exactly as your customers see it. To come back to your own space: Profile, then « {{lien}} ».
visitePro.revoirTexte: Five steps to understand your four tabs, with an example order.
